fields.basis: Course-standard 25 mm/s assumption; 150 independently detected small-square intervals across 738 pixels
fields.reason: Mean R–R estimate 142.3 bpm; six-second count estimate 140 bpm. All seconds/bpm depend on course-standard 25 mm/s. Count estimate assumes 150 small squares = 6 seconds; endpoint phase and partial complexes affect it. On irregular strips the count estimate is not a stable instantaneous rate. Mean RR describes only intervals between observed peaks.

fields.value: Candidate P-wave observation: Very low pre-QRS humps recur, but they arise on an already rising inter-complex contour without a consistently separate T-to-P boundary. Definite P identification remains unresolved. Candidate humps near x58, 112 and 164 precede the measured complexes. Their temporal repetition is compatible with an atrial candidate but cannot exclude the preceding terminal wave or merged T/P.
